s0.ru: Есть {n} гирь массами {weights}. Груз массы {target} стоит на левой чаше. Каждую гирю ставят на левую чашу вместе с грузом, на правую чашу или не используют. В записи положения -1 означает левую чашу, 1 — правую, 0 — гиря не используется. Чаши должны уравновеситься. Найдите суммарную массу гирь на правой чаше.
s0.en: There are {n} weights of masses {weights}. An object of mass {target} is on the left pan. Each weight goes on the left pan with the object, on the right pan, or stays unused. In the placement code, -1 means the left pan, 1 means the right pan, and 0 means unused. The pans must balance. Find the total mass of the weights on the right pan.

s1.en: There are {n} weights of masses {weights}. An object of mass {target} is on the left pan. Each weight goes on the left pan with the object, on the right pan, or stays unused. In the placement code, -1 means the left pan, 1 means the right pan, and 0 means unused. The pans must balance. How many weights are used?

s3.en: The right pan holds {right}, and {used} weights are used.
